author: DaiqingChen
body: * **The annotations of collagen type XI trimer (GO:0005592) within homo sapients are as follow:** Contain COL2A1, COL5A2, COL11A1, COL11A2, COL28A1 ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5e67df70-cfa9-46cc-8d58-e655ef6a7a7d) * **Gene product name and ID to be annotated to this term** Should be COL11A1, COL11A2,COL2A1(COL11A3), COL5A1, COL5A2. Need to add: COL5A1 Need to remove: COL28A1 in all species, Col4a1_0 in smithornis capensis, col9a1b in Betta splendens, Col27a1 in Castor canadensis. These annotations are inferred from phylogenetic tree, screenshot of the last three are as follow: * **Reference, in format PMID:#######** In complex protal (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/complexportal/home), there are three collagen type XI trimer: [Variant 1](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/complexportal/complex/CPX-1750) has COL2A1, COL11A1, COL11A2; [Variant 2](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/complexportal/complex/CPX-1751) has 2*COL5A2, COL11A2; [Variant 3](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/complexportal/complex/CPX-1752) has COL5A1, COL5A2, COL11A1.
title: Update gene product of collagen type XI trimer
